## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.17
**Fixed** - **Finder menu** — "Open in Terminal" and other Finder actions no longer occasionally trigger the wrong menu item. - **Encrypt / Decrypt Safes** — creating a new encrypted file is more reliable, and the progress window no longer stretches off-screen when a file path is long. - **Blackout** — toggling is steadier while an external display finishes mirroring. - **Rectangle conflict** — when macOS blocks removing Rectangle's login item, DeskHelper now sends you straight to the right Automation setting.
**Improved** - **Encrypt / Compress dialog** — a clearer split between password-protected encryption and no-password compression, the dialog now opens next to your pointer, and password checks happen inline without a separate pop-up. - **Localization** — more of the app's messages are fully translated.
